implementation_constraints: Must exit 0 to allow, exit 2 to block
Reason written to stderr on block

unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec forbids 'pipeline in which any stage is a writer'. To avoid inspecting every possible pipeline stage, default-deny: any pipe + .approved = block. This catches cat|tee without needing a tee whitelist.
Spec requires 'recognized read-only operation' but does not enumerate them. Chose commands whose only side-effect is stdout/exit-code. Awk and sed included because -i check runs first.

unresolved_intent.decision: block commands starting with unknown tools
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec: 'Treat the command as a WRITE unless every part of it is a recognised read-only operation.' Unknown tool -> cannot prove safe -> block (fail-closed).

unresolved_intent.decision: block > and >>, check for | and > only (not 2>, 1>)
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec examples focus on stdout/pipe; stderr redirect (2>) is out of scope per fail-closed stance. If a command redirects stdout or pipes, block; complex redirect patterns left as edge case.
